 Education secretary: war in Iran makes student loan reform harder
 By Harriet Swain 
 Share 
 Share on Facebook 
 Share on X

 Share on Linkedin 
 Share via email 
 Image:  House of Commons [ CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 ], via Flickr 
 Lucy Powell says impact of conflict on public finances is impeding reform 
 The financial impact of the war in Iran was a factor in the UK government’s decision not to address concerns over student loan repayment terms, the education secretary has said.
 Speaking to the Commons education committee on 4 November, Lucy Powell said that while the possible unfairness of the loans system was “something I care strongly about”, the extra impact put on government finances by the war in Iran, started by the US and Israel in February, had made it difficult for the government to address it.
